purpose: §26: durable post-recovery snapshot, so a future loss is recoverable without paid LLM reconstruction.

snapshot.takenAfter: Both the FWRG and LSB real compiler runs, the full 2515/2515 green vitest run, and the `_prisma_migrations` bookkeeping repair.

honestDurabilityCaveat: This sandboxed session's own filesystem (including its scratchpad) does NOT survive container teardown - 'durable' within this environment realistically means only two things: (1) the git repository itself, which must NEVER hold a binary Postgres dump (this project's own standing discipline, correctly upheld throughout this incident response), or (2) handing the actual dump file to the user via the file-delivery mechanism available in this session, so THEY hold a copy outside this container. This artifact records that option (2) is the one being exercised - see this session's own final message to the user, which offers the dump file directly.
whatThisActuallyPrevents: It does not prevent a future concurrent-migration-tooling incident by itself (that is what 11-13's isolation architecture is for). It prevents a future incident of this exact shape from AGAIN requiring a ~$1.5 paid re-run of the FWRG/LSB compiler - restoring from this dump reproduces the exact recovered state without any new LLM calls, as long as the restore happens before schema drift makes the dump incompatible with a later prisma/schema.prisma.
